_what: People the institute rosters list as currently in the Clevers group but whom PubMed has not yet attached to a paper with Clevers. They carry no papers, so the pages draw them at the size of a single publication.
_why_empty: hubrecht.eu and prinsesmaximacentrum.nl both answer automated requests with HTTP 403, and web.archive.org is unreachable from this environment, so the rosters could not be read. Paste them in here and re-run scripts/build_universe.py --inject.

_fields.name: Surname, Given names — same form as PubMed uses, e.g. "Puschhof, Jens"
_fields.since: year they joined, as an integer
_fields.role: PhD student / postdoc / technician / staff scientist / ...
